summary: Texas Roadhouse, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K reporting third-quarter 2026 results and declaring a quarterly dividend. The November 5, 2026 press release showed 13-week revenue of $1.573 billion (+9.5% year over year), income from operations of $102.99 million (+6.2%), net income of $89.36 million (+7.4%), and diluted EPS of $1.36 (+8.6%); comparable restaurant sales rose 4.3%. The board declared a $0.75 per-share cash dividend payable December 29, 2026 to holders of record December 1, 2026. No transaction or structural event; watch dividend sustainability versus ongoing unit growth and margin trends.
